facts.fact: Bankable reports that the Bureau burundais de normalisation et de contrôle de la qualité (BBN) signed a memorandum with the Congolese Office congolais de contrôle in Bujumbura on 29 August 2025 on cooperation in standardisation, quality control and certification, so a national standards body exists; the article names no IT or data standard.
